about: Demo questions for MM LLM with expected answers and evidence. Each check is a SQL boolean over the tool functions (the same ones the orchestrator calls); :org is the Demo Mill org id. tools/ingest/verify_answers.py runs them as a signed-in member, so row-level security applies. Demo 'today' is 2026-10-31.

questions.question: What should we prioritize for the Nov 11 outage?
questions.expect: Lead with the dryer can 27 DS bearing: outer race defect on the Oct 19 vibration route (0.24 in/s, Alert), rising since early September, WO scheduled for Nov 11 with parts not reserved. Also: BP 1 and BP 2 refiner plates due with only one Ridgeway set on hand, the 2nd section drive coupling (parts not reserved), and the 6 WOs carried over from the annual.

checks.desc: Nov 11 scope has the can 27 bearing WO with parts not reserved
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_outage_scope(:org, 'OUT-2026-11-11') where description ilike '%can 27 DS bearing%' and parts_status = 'Not reserved')

checks.desc: Bonvoy flagged can 27 on most days after the annual restart
checks.sql: (select count(*) from public.mm_llm_bonvoy(:org, 'PM1:DRY2_C27_DS_VIB', '2026-10-12', '2026-10-31')) >= 15

checks.desc: the Oct 19 vibration route is found for 'can 27 outer race defect'
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_search_docs(:org, 'can 27 outer race defect', 3) where doc_id = 'KV-VR-261019')

checks.desc: both base ply plate changes are in the Nov 11 scope
checks.sql: (select count(*) from public.mm_llm_outage_scope(:org, 'OUT-2026-11-11') where description in ('Change BP 1 refiner plates', 'Change BP 2 refiner plates')) = 2

show.label: Bonvoy: can 27 DS bearing since the restart

questions.question: When did we first see the can 27 problem?
questions.expect: Bonvoy first flagged the can 27 DS bearing on Sep 22 (report Sep 23); the Sep 14 route already showed a BPFO tone at 0.07 in/s. It was flagged before the Oct 5 annual outage but was not in the annual scope.

checks.desc: first Bonvoy flag on can 27 DS is Sep 22
checks.sql: (select min(period) from public.mm_llm_bonvoy(:org, 'PM1:DRY2_C27_DS_VIB', '2026-08-01', null)) = '2026-09-22'

checks.desc: the Sep 14 route mentions BPFO
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_search_docs(:org, 'BPFO tone', 5) where doc_id = 'KV-VR-260914')

checks.desc: can 27 was not in the annual scope
checks.sql: not exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_outage_scope(:org, 'OUT-2026-ANNUAL') where description ilike '%can 27%')

show.label: Bonvoy: can 27 DS bearing, first flags
Annual outage scope mentioning can 27
show.empty: None - can 27 was not in the annual scope

questions.question: We're steam limited on 33# again and the 2nd press Uhle vacuum is creeping up. What should we check?
questions.expect: Same pattern as March-April: plugged 2nd press HP shower nozzles (18% plugged on the Apr 15 audit) filled the felt (high fill on the Halden survey), per RCFA-2026-03. Check the HP shower nozzles and strainer; the filtered-water action from that RCFA is still open.

checks.desc: shower audit with 18% plugged is found
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_search_docs(:org, '2nd press HP shower plugged nozzles', 5) where doc_id = 'SN-SA-260415')

checks.desc: RCFA-2026-03 is in the felt's history
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_position_history(:org, 'p2-felt-top') where source = 'RCFA' and ref = 'RCFA-2026-03')

checks.desc: the filtered-water action is still open
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_position_history(:org, 'p2-felt-top') where source = 'Action' and summary ilike '%filtered water%' and status not ilike 'Completed%')

checks.desc: Bonvoy flagged the 2nd press Uhle vacuum from Mar 24
checks.sql: (select min(period) from public.mm_llm_bonvoy(:org, 'PM1:UHLE_P2_VAC', '2026-03-01', '2026-04-20')) = '2026-03-24'

show.label: Documents: "2nd press HP shower plugged nozzles"

questions.question: Why did the 2nd press felt come off early in April?
questions.expect: High fill from plugged HP shower nozzles: Halden survey and Spraywell audit of Apr 15; pulled at 6 of 12 weeks.

checks.desc: the early felt change WO is in the history
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_position_history(:org, 'p2-felt-top') where source = 'WO' and summary ilike '%pulled early%')

checks.desc: the Halden Apr 15 survey is linked to the felt
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_position_history(:org, 'p2-felt-top') where source = 'Document' and ref = 'HF-SV-260415')

questions.question: Draft the RCFA timeline for the Feb 18 base ply wire hole.

questions.question: Which RCFA actions are overdue?

questions.question: Do we have what we need for refiner plates at the Nov 11 outage?
questions.expect: No: BP 1 and BP 2 are both due Nov 11 and BP 2 is wearing fast (Bonvoy SE flags from Oct 13, Ridgeway annual inspection: elevated edge rounding). Only one Ridgeway set is on hand and the order action is still open.

checks.desc: first BP 2 SE flag is Oct 13
checks.sql: (select min(period) from public.mm_llm_bonvoy(:org, 'PM1:REF_BP2_SE', '2026-08-15', null)) = '2026-10-13'

checks.desc: the Ridgeway inspection is found for 'edge rounding'

checks.desc: the plate order action is open

checks.desc: the BUS sheet says one set on hand

questions.question: Is there a pattern behind the breaks at the 3rd section this summer?
questions.expect: About 22 breaks Jun-Aug at the 3rd section and calender, more on 26# and hot afternoons, lining up with low PV-3 pocket ventilation fan amps (Bonvoy flagged twice in the July cluster). The PV-3 damper WO was closed 'could not reproduce' and there is no RCFA.

checks.desc: 22 break lines on the BUS sheet for the 3rd section top felt and calender top roll, Jun–Aug
checks.sql: (select count(*) from public.mm_llm_position_history(:org, '3rd section top felt', '2026-06-01', '2026-08-31') where source = 'BUS' and summary like 'Break%') + (select count(*) from public.mm_llm_position_history(:org, 'Calender top roll', '2026-06-01', '2026-08-31') where source = 'BUS' and summary like 'Break%') = 22

checks.desc: Bonvoy flagged PV-3 amps twice in Jul 12–20
checks.sql: (select count(*) from public.mm_llm_bonvoy(:org, 'PM1:DRY3_PV_FAN_AMPS', '2026-07-12', '2026-07-20')) = 2

checks.desc: the PV-3 WO was closed as could not reproduce
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_position_history(:org, '3rd section pocket ventilation') where source = 'WO' and summary ilike '%could not reproduce%')

show.label: 3rd section top felt: BUS break lines (Jun-Aug)
Bonvoy: PV-3 pocket ventilation fan amps (summer)

questions.question: How did the last forming fabric trial go?
questions.expect: Halden PF-3315 on the base ply, Dec 10 - Jan 21: formation equal, but slower drainage (higher couch vacuum) and about 15 fpm lost on 33#; the mill went back to the Northbank NX-2740.

checks.desc: the end-of-trial report is found
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_search_docs(:org, 'PF-3315 trial', 5) where doc_id = 'HF-TR-260121')

questions.question: When was the calender bottom roll last ground, and what did they find?
questions.expect: Reground during the October 2026 annual outage (removed Oct 6) after the May 27 Teague inspection found hardness drifting high and crown at the low edge; post-grind report Oct 20: 85.2 Shore D, crown 0.020 in.

checks.desc: the post-grind report is found
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_search_docs(:org, 'calender bottom roll regrind', 5) where doc_id = 'TR-RS-261020')

checks.desc: the scanned May report is searchable (OCR text)
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_search_docs(:org, 'hardness drifted high crown tolerance', 5) where doc_id = 'TR-RS-260527')
